description:
【Experience Immense Power to Conquer More Trails】 Unleash your adventurous spirit with Happyrun Tank Electric Bicycle, designed for both trail riding and commuting. Equipped with a 1500W (Peak) top-notch brushless motor, it can surge to a speed of 30MPH, empowering you to navigate across diverse road conditions and inclines like a pro.
【Go the Extra Mile】 With its 48V 18AH removable battery, our Tank eBike offers an impressive range of 68 miles per charge that lasts 5-6 hours. The detachable battery design allows easy charging at home or at your workspace, enhancing convenience.
【Discover Boundless Pathways】 The 20" x 4" Fat Tire Defense is engineered to offer additional protection against punctures from small materials such as thorns and glass. Its superior design enables you to conquer sandy, snowy, and other complex terrains, turning every ride into an effortless adventure.
【Unmatched Comfort for Long-Distance Rides】 Our electric bike boasts high-performance front fork suspension and seat suspension that effectively absorb most road bumps, ensuring a smoother and more comfortable ride. The dual mechanical disc brakes provide exceptional stopping power in various road conditions, guaranteeing safe rides.
【Your Adventure Awaits】 The Happyrun Tank Electric Bike arrives 90% pre-assembled, reducing complicated assembly time, so you're ready to roll in no time! Please retain the original e-bike package for potential returns.
【Prompt and Dedicated Service】 We offer a two-year warranty on the electric motor, battery, and charger, demonstrating our commitment to quality. If you encounter any difficulties, feel free to contact us. We promise a response within 24 hours. Orders are shipped from California within 48 hours of placement to ensure swift delivery. Your thrilling adventure starts here with Happyrun Tank Electric Bike!
